description_en: Modifies the name and description of a traffic classification rule
description_zh: 编辑流分类规则的名称和描述
name: ModifyTrafficMatchRuleToTrafficMarkingPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run. The system does not add a traffic categorization rule to the traffic marking policy. Instead, the system checks whether the required request parameters are specified, whether the request format is valid, and whether the business restrictions are met. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): sends a normal request. After the request passes the check, the traffic categorization rule is added to the traffic marking policy
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会为流量标记策略添加流分类规则。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制等。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接为流量标记策略添加流分类规则
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The ID of the traffic marking policy
parameters.name: traffic_marking_policy_id

parameters.name: traffic_match_rule_id

parameters.help_en:

The name can be empty or 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://

名称可以为空或长度为1～128个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
